storylines.text: Byron Buxton is in a real home run drought — none in his last 10 games — but the underlying indicators haven't cooled the same way: a .208 ISO and a 0.899 OPS this season say the power is still there, it just hasn't landed yet. ATH sends out Jacob Lopez today.

Shea Langeliers is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.260 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces MIN sends out Zebby Matthews today, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.268 average against this season.

Mike Trout is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.234 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces SF sends out Logan Webb today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.228 average against this season. This pitcher has also been genuinely tougher to hit hard once he gets to two strikes this season, not just generically good.
